## Purpose and structure

Data were extracted into a structured relational form with four nested levels. One
published report generates one Level 1 record, and may contribute several Level 3
records (one per treatment arm) and many Level 4 records (one per outcome,
definition and timepoint). Level 2 exists to identify reports that draw on the same
underlying patient cohort, so that the same patients cannot enter a single model
more than once.

| Level | Unit of observation | One record per | Fields |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Publication | published report | 32 |
| 2 | Registry cohort | underlying patient cohort | 10 |
| 3 | Treatment arm | arm within a report | 93 |
| 4 | Outcome record | outcome × definition × timepoint × arm | 34 |
| 4b | Outcome subgroup record | stratum within an outcome record | 37 |

## Coding conventions

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Y` / `N` | Present / absent |
| `NR` | Not reported in the source publication |
| `UNCL` | Mentioned but insufficiently specified to classify |
| `mixed` | The arm pools more than one category (e.g. two donor types) |

Percentages are recorded on a 0–100 scale to one decimal place; counts are
integers; dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). Values are never imputed at extraction:
where a datum is absent, `NR` is recorded and the missingness is handled at the
analysis stage. Event counts are required for meta-analysis and are never
back-calculated from cumulative incidence; the single exception to the
no-derivation rule is documented at Level 3 (systemic steroid exposure) and is
flagged in `extraction_notes`.

## Level 4 — Outcome record

One record per arm × outcome × definition × timepoint.

| Field | Definition / instruction | Response |
|---|---|---|
| `outcome_id` | Unique outcome-record identifier | Integer |
| `arm_id` | Parent arm | Integer |
| `study_id` | Parent publication | Integer |
| `cohort_id` | Parent cohort | Integer |
| `outcome_category` | Outcome domain (e.g. acute GVHD, CMV, bloodstream infection, survival) | Free text, controlled |
| `outcome_subtype` | Specific definition within the domain (e.g. grade II–IV) | Free text, controlled |
| `timepoint` | Assessment timepoint as reported | `D+30` / `D+100` / `D+180` / `D+365_1yr` / `D+730_2yr` / `D+1095_3yr` / `end_of_followup` |
| `timepoint_days_numeric` | Timepoint expressed in days | Integer |
| `is_primary_timepoint` | Flags the timepoint carried into the primary analysis | `Y` / `N` |
| `is_primary_definition` | Flags the definition carried into the primary analysis | `Y` / `N` |
| `denominator_n` | Patients at risk for this outcome | Integer |
| `event_count` | Number of events. Required for meta-analysis; never derived from cumulative incidence | Integer |
| `proportion_reported_pct` | Crude proportion as printed | ___ % |
| `cumulative_incidence_pct` | Cumulative incidence as printed | ___ % |
| `ci_lower_pct` | Lower confidence bound | ___ % |
| `ci_upper_pct` | Upper confidence bound | ___ % |
| `ci_method` | Estimator used | `Kaplan_Meier` / `Gray_CIF` / `Aalen_Johansen` / `crude_proportion` |
| `competing_risks_handled` | Whether competing risks were accounted for | `Y_CIF` / `N_KM_or_crude` |
| `hr_value` | Hazard ratio, where reported | Numeric |
| `hr_ci_lower` | Lower bound of the hazard ratio | Numeric |
| `hr_ci_upper` | Upper bound of the hazard ratio | Numeric |
| `hr_comparator_arm_id` | Arm serving as the reference | Integer |
| `hr_adjusted` | Whether the hazard ratio is adjusted | `adjusted` / `unadjusted` |
| `incidence_rate_value` | Incidence rate, where reported | Numeric |
| `incidence_rate_unit` | Rate denominator | `per_1000_pt_days` / `other` |
| `person_time_total` | Total person-time observed | Numeric |
| `person_time_unit` | Person-time unit | `patient_days` |
| `median_time_to_event_days` | Median time to the event | Numeric |
| `ascertainment_method` | How the outcome was detected | `routine_screening` / `active_surveillance` / `clinical_only` / `mixed` |
| `screening_frequency_per_week` | Screening frequency where applicable | Numeric (per week) |
| `definition_text` | Verbatim outcome definition from the source | Free text |
| `data_source` | Location of the datum in the report | `table` / `narrative_text` / `figure_text` / `figure_KM_curve` / `derived` / `computed_from_other_fields` |
| `data_quality_flag` | Provenance of the recorded value | `direct` / `derived` / `back_calculated` / `estimated_from_figure` / `computed_from_other_fields` |
| `extraction_notes` | Audit trail for this record | Free text |

### Level 4b — Outcome subgroup record

Subgroup strata were extracted opportunistically where reported. These records
carry every Level 4 field, plus:

| Field | Definition / instruction | Response |
|---|---|---|
| `parent_outcome_id` | Level 4 record this stratum belongs to | Integer |
| `moderator_variable` | Variable defining the stratum (e.g. donor type, pathogen) | Free text |
| `moderator_value` | Level of that variable for this record | Free text |

## Risk-of-bias assessment form

One record per report per tool. ROBINS-I was applied to non-randomised studies
and RoB 2 to randomised trials; RoB 2 populates domains 1–5 only.

| Field | Definition / instruction | Response |
|---|---|---|
| `rob_id` | Unique assessment identifier | Integer |
| `study_id` | Report assessed | Integer |
| `reviewer` | Assessor initials | Initials |
| `rob_tool` | Instrument applied | `ROBINS-I` / `RoB2` |
| `d1` | ROBINS-I: confounding. RoB 2: randomisation process | Judgement (below) |
| `d2` | ROBINS-I: selection of participants. RoB 2: deviations from intended intervention | Judgement |
| `d3` | ROBINS-I: classification of interventions. RoB 2: missing outcome data | Judgement |
| `d4` | ROBINS-I: deviations from intended interventions. RoB 2: measurement of the outcome | Judgement |
| `d5` | ROBINS-I: missing data. RoB 2: selection of the reported result | Judgement |
| `d6` | ROBINS-I: measurement of outcomes | Judgement |
| `d7` | ROBINS-I: selection of the reported result | Judgement |
| `overall_judgement` | Overall risk of bias for the report | Judgement |
| `justification_text` | Free-text rationale supporting the judgement | Free text |
| `assessment_date` | Date of assessment | YYYY-MM-DD |

Permitted judgements: ROBINS-I — `low`, `moderate`, `serious`, `critical`, `NI`
(no information); RoB 2 — `low`, `some_concerns`, `high`.
